headline: Anthropic to Engadget, 23 July: "We're continuing to invest in voice and we'll have more to share later this year." Nothing further by 17 November. It names no speech model, so it counts at half weight until 31 December.
note: Engadget, 2026-07-23 (opened 2026-11-17 12:34 UTC), direct quote attributed to Anthropic: '"This release is focused on intelligence and tool access," Anthropic told Engadget. "We're continuing to invest in voice and we'll have more to share later this year."' Added 2026-11-17: the statement was in the article V6 cites and had not been logged. Stage dated_months because it is a first-party 'later this year' (DAILY_RUNBOOK.md 12). Grade B, as V6: an on-record statement printed by a news outlet, on no first-party page. specific 'no': it promises 'more to share' about voice and names no model; new voices, languages, a redesigned Voice screen or a newer text model in voice mode would all satisfy it, and none would resolve a rung. TREATMENT (Jacob's decision, 2026-11-17, voice-v1.1): half weight. The published curve is 0.5 x the forecast without this statement's clock + 0.5 x the forecast with the dated_months clock at full strength (voice_params.json, signals.unnamed_statement; EXPERIMENTS.md V7). The rule was calibrated on statements that named a model (Claude 3.5 Haiku, 124 days; Claude 3.5 Opus, never); this one names none, hence the weight. expires 2026-12-31: 'later this year' ends there, and from 2027-01-01 the clock no longer contributes; then set status to 'lapsed' and record the undelivered promise in LEARNINGS.md. As first logged earlier on 2026-11-17 the row had no effect on the number. Status on 2026-11-17 (117 days on, 44 days left in the year): no voice or speech announcement in the app release notes, newsroom, claude.com blog, API release notes or Claude Code changelog since 2026-07-23; the statement is undelivered.
